name: neoswitch
description: Use Claude Code with Gemini 4 Neon through a local Anthropic-compatible proxy. Route each project with Antigravity OAuth, Gemini API, or Vertex AI.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Used by the local NeoSwitch proxy. Leave empty to use GEMINI_API_KEY or Vertex AI credentials from your environment.

antigravity_oauth.title: Use Antigravity OAuth via ACP
antigravity_oauth.description: Use the official agy ACP session and the signed-in Gemini 4 Neon account instead of a Gemini API key.
